newsitem.title: FRANCE: Vallourec eyes op.profit at 10pct of sales.
newsitem.headline: Vallourec eyes op.profit at 10pct of sales.

text.p: French tube maker Vallourec said on Wednesday it hopes to achieve an average gross operating profit of more than 10 percent of turnover in the long run.
"We will not reach 10 percent in 1997 but we will be close," Vallourec chairman Jean-Claude Cadre said.

Taking into account the cyclical nature of the group's activity, a 10 percent target meant that in some years Vallourec would have to achieve a gross operating profit well above 10 percent of sales, Cadre said.
Vallourec said on Tuesday 1996 net profit was 196 million francs, up from 85 million in 1995, and its gross operating profit of 611 million francs was 7.9 percent of turnover.
